decisions.title: R-22-38: University Metropolitan Redevelopment Area Designation Resolution
decisions.description: The signed City Council resolution designates the University Metropolitan Redevelopment Area, finds statutory blight conditions along Central and Yale, and authorizes preparation of a redevelopment plan addressing land use, transportation, utilities, housing, commercial activity, rehabilitation, and conservation.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Legistar matter record and enacted attachment reviewed; signed original verified visually
processing_notes: Original official enacted resolution preserved without modification.
Rendered signature page confirms 9-0 Council adoption on August 1, 2022 and mayoral approval on August 12, 2022.
The final designation report is already retained as canonical candidate src-89107d80d63d016c; it is not being archived again.

decisions.title: 2009 Community Facilities General Obligation Bond Project Scopes
decisions.description: Lists 2009 City general-obligation bond project scopes totaling $52.35 million for affordable housing, cultural facilities, City buildings, environmental health, community centers, technology, planning, redevelopment, libraries, animal welfare, and senior facilities.
processing_notes: Original City PDF preserved without modification.
